projectTitle: Accessible Science: Expanding the Synthetic Cell Toolkit for All
projectTitle_zh: 可及的科學：為所有人擴展合成細胞工具組
tagline: A cheap polyphosphate-powered energy module, a reproducible synthetic-cell fabrication device, and the calibrated ATP assay that makes both measurable.
tagline_zh: 一個便宜的多磷酸鹽供能模組、一台能可重現製作合成細胞的裝置，以及讓兩者都能被量測的經校正 ATP 分析法。
summary: Cal Poly SLO built a cell-free and synthetic-cell platform aimed at putting synthetic cells into undergraduate hands. The science problem is that PURE-type cell-free reactions run out of energy and that commercial creatine-phosphate regeneration is one of the most expensive parts of the kit, so the team screened a library of polyphosphate kinase 2 (PPK2) enzymes, filtered from roughly 18,000 sequences down to 16 phylogenetically diverse candidates, that regenerate ATP from cheap inorganic polyphosphate. To compare those enzymes they had to build the measurement first: a scalable, interference-corrected luciferase ATP assay with matched standard curves, published protocols, OpenTrons scripts and Excel templates. They also designed a 3D-printed emulsification 'washboard' and a tip-wipe recovery step to make hand-made vesicles reproducible, and wrote the whole thing into CHEM 471, a new undergraduate synthetic-cell lab course.
summary_zh: Cal Poly SLO 做了一套無細胞與合成細胞平台，目標是把合成細胞交到大學生手上。科學問題在於 PURE 類型的無細胞反應會耗盡能量，而商用的磷酸肌酸再生系統又是整組套件中最貴的部分之一，因此團隊篩選了一組多磷酸鹽激酶 2（PPK2）酵素庫，從大約 18,000 條序列過濾到 16 個在親緣關係上具多樣性的候選，這些酵素能以便宜的無機多磷酸鹽再生 ATP。為了比較這些酵素，他們得先把量測方法做出來：一套可擴充、已校正干擾的螢光素酶 ATP 分析法，具備條件相符的標準曲線、公開的實驗流程、OpenTrons 腳本與 Excel 範本。他們也設計了一個 3D 列印的乳化「洗衣板」以及一道擦拭吸頭的回收步驟，讓手工製作的囊泡變得可重現，並把整套內容寫進 CHEM 471，一門全新的大學部合成細胞實驗課。

dry.frameworks: Design-Build-Test-Learn applied separately to the assay, to the 3D-printed emulsification device (v0 to v8) and to the course materials; an explicit 'problem -> approach -> solution -> outcome' framing on every major page; measurement treated as a prerequisite for enzyme screening rather than a reporting step; Human Practices feedback logged as 'feedback -> action' pairs that changed protocols.
dry.frameworks_zh: Design-Build-Test-Learn 分別套用在分析方法、3D 列印乳化裝置（v0 到 v8）與課程教材上；每個主要頁面都有明確的問題、方法、解法、結果四段架構；量測被視為酵素篩選的前提條件，而不是最後的呈報步驟；人類實踐的回饋則以回饋對行動的配對記錄，而這些行動確實改動了實驗流程。
dry.dataviz: Interactive charts embedded in the wiki (per-condition time courses, Michaelis-Menten fits, reproducibility datasets) with selectable conditions; side-by-side uncorrected vs corrected Michaelis-Menten fits; log-scaled ATP standard curves; per-cell log10 GFP scatter plots across 24 timepoints with per-timepoint median lines and a dashed per-plate subpopulation threshold; a two-clock explainer diagram teaching readers how to read the quench-validation figures; SolidWorks drawings of every finalized 3D-printed part.
dry.dataviz_zh: wiki 中嵌入互動圖表（各條件的時間曲線、Michaelis-Menten 擬合、重現性資料集）並可自行選擇條件；未校正與已校正的 Michaelis-Menten 擬合並排對照；對數座標的 ATP 標準曲線；跨 24 個時間點的單細胞 log10 GFP 散布圖，附每個時間點的中位數線與每片盤各自的次族群虛線門檻；一張「兩個時鐘」的解說圖，教讀者如何讀終止反應驗證的圖表；以及每一個定稿 3D 列印零件的 SolidWorks 圖。
dry.datascience: The core contribution is an ATP assay that was validated before it was trusted. Three quench methods were compared head to head (cold dilution, 95 C heat stop, EDTA chelation) by sampling a DrPPK2 reaction at fixed reaction times and then varying the hold time before adding CellTiter-Glo; a flat line means the reaction stopped, a rising line means it did not. EDTA was chosen because it scales to 16 enzymes in pre-poured plates, and the concentration was then tuned from 10 mM to 5 mM when enzyme load dropped from 50 to 7.5 ng/uL. The team then defined the assay's reliable ATP range by testing whether they could extend Promega's 10 nM to 1 uM window in either direction, found they could not (0.061 nM ATP still read above 10,000 RLU; the 100 uM standard deviated from linearity), and committed to reading only inside that range and never extrapolating, discarding data that fell outside. Because EDTA, AMP and ADP all suppress luciferase, every sample is compared against ATP standards prepared at the same pre-reagent EDTA concentration and the same substrate concentration, and the ratio of slopes gives per-condition correction factors (tabulated for all eight AMP and ADP levels at both 1:25 and 1:50 dilutions, e.g. AMP CF 0.0822 at 2 mM and 0.6113 at 0.0156 mM) that are hard-coded into the published Excel templates. Correcting recovers the kinetic trend that inhibition had destroyed: the same DrPPK2 AMP dataset moves from Km 0.020 mM / Vmax 5.66 uM/min uncorrected to Km 0.139 mM / Vmax 23.2 uM/min corrected, and the 2 mM AMP point is openly excluded from the fit because the correction does not fully recover it. Benchmark kinetics are reported with R2 (DrPPK2 ADP Km 0.985 mM, Vmax 11.7 uM/min, R2 0.9894; ManPPK2 ADP Km 2.67 mM, Vmax 42.6 uM/min, R2 0.9993; FtPPK2 ADP Km 3.16 mM, Vmax 80.05 uM/min, R2 0.9963). Reproducibility was tested as an experiment in its own right: three team members ran the same full-range assay on the same enzyme aliquot on the same day, giving Km 0.0775 +/- 0.0145 mM and Vmax 8.62 +/- 1.39 uM/min, and the team states plainly that these do not match the earlier full-range values and lists the candidate causes (different purification batch, new polyP lot, new AMP lot) as unresolved. Microscopy is handled by a named pipeline, CellScope, which runs Cellpose segmentation at 1.332 um/pixel after 4x downsampling, exports one row per object per timepoint to parquet (over a million objects on one plate), applies a QC gate on diameter 5 to 60 um, circularity 0.80 to 1.25 and no saturated pixels, reports each well as fold over its own background, and runs a two-mode (delta-BIC) test for subpopulations; a dedicated figure documents a case where the segmentation silently failed on a visibly good well, which the team published rather than hid. Every bulk plate carries a 0.125 uM fluorescein well as a dye reference, and the wiki maintains an explicit glossary distinguishing RFU (plate reader) from AU (microscope) as non-comparable units.
dry.datascience_zh: 核心貢獻是一套先驗證、才信任的 ATP 分析法。三種終止反應的方法被正面比較（低溫稀釋、95 C 加熱終止、EDTA 螯合）：在固定反應時間取 DrPPK2 反應的樣本，再改變加入 CellTiter-Glo 之前的靜置時間；曲線平坦代表反應真的停了，上升則代表沒停。最後選擇 EDTA，因為它可以在預先分盤的情況下擴充到 16 種酵素；當酵素用量從 50 ng/uL 降到 7.5 ng/uL 時，濃度也從 10 mM 調到 5 mM。接著團隊界定這套分析法可靠的 ATP 範圍：測試能否把 Promega 給的 10 nM 到 1 uM 視窗往任一方向延伸，結果發現不行（0.061 nM 的 ATP 讀值仍高於 10,000 RLU；100 uM 的標準品則偏離線性），於是決定只讀這個範圍內的值、絕不外推，落在範圍外的資料一律丟棄。由於 EDTA、AMP 與 ADP 都會抑制螢光素酶，每個樣本都要對照在相同的試劑前 EDTA 濃度與相同基質濃度下配製的 ATP 標準品，兩者斜率的比值就給出各條件的校正因子（1:25 與 1:50 兩種稀釋倍率下、八個 AMP 與 ADP 濃度全都列表，例如 AMP 在 2 mM 時校正因子為 0.0822、在 0.0156 mM 時為 0.6113），這些因子直接寫進公開的 Excel 範本裡。校正之後，被抑制效應破壞掉的動力學趨勢又回來了：同一份 DrPPK2 的 AMP 資料，未校正時為 Km 0.020 mM、Vmax 5.66 uM/min，校正後變成 Km 0.139 mM、Vmax 23.2 uM/min；而 2 mM AMP 這一點則公開排除在擬合之外，因為校正並沒有完全把它救回來。基準動力學參數都附上 R2（DrPPK2 對 ADP 的 Km 0.985 mM、Vmax 11.7 uM/min、R2 0.9894；ManPPK2 對 ADP 的 Km 2.67 mM、Vmax 42.6 uM/min、R2 0.9993；FtPPK2 對 ADP 的 Km 3.16 mM、Vmax 80.05 uM/min、R2 0.9963）。重現性本身被當成一個獨立的實驗來測：三位隊員在同一天、用同一管酵素分裝，跑同一套全範圍分析，得到 Km 0.0775 ± 0.0145 mM 與 Vmax 8.62 ± 1.39 uM/min；團隊直言這些數值與先前的全範圍結果並不一致，並列出可能原因（不同批次的純化、新批號的 polyP、新批號的 AMP），標註為尚未釐清。顯微影像交由一條有名字的流程 CellScope 處理：先做 4 倍降採樣，再以 1.332 um/pixel 執行 Cellpose 分割，把每個物件在每個時間點各自輸出一列到 parquet（單一盤超過一百萬個物件），套用品管門檻（直徑 5 到 60 um、圓形度 0.80 到 1.25、不得有飽和像素），每個孔都以相對於自身背景的倍數回報，並以雙峰（delta-BIC）檢定判斷是否存在次族群；另有一張專門的圖記錄了一個案例：在一個肉眼看起來很好的孔上，分割默默失敗了，而團隊選擇公開而不是藏起來。每一片批量盤都放一個 0.125 uM 螢光素孔作為染劑參照，wiki 也維護一份明確的術語表，把 RFU（盤式讀取儀）與 AU（顯微鏡）區分為不可互相比較的單位。
dry.software: OpenTrons OT-2 Python protocols for dilution-plate creation and dilution execution (full-range and confirmatory, four enzymes), published as .py downloads; Excel analysis templates for the full-range AMP, full-range ADP and confirmatory assays with correction factors built in; a master-mix calculator, titration design workbooks, plate-map template and osmolarity worksheet; the CellScope image-analysis pipeline (Cellpose segmentation, OzaLabCP/Imageanalysis) with a published vesicle_pipeline.txt; STL files for the washboard insert and rubber-band sled; raw time-course data and raw image data/masks released. All downloads are collected on https://2026.igem.wiki/calpolyslo/downloads and the lab manuals are released under CC BY 4.0.
dry.software_zh: OpenTrons OT-2 的 Python 流程，用於建立稀釋盤與執行稀釋（全範圍與確認性版本，四種酵素），以 .py 檔案公開下載；全範圍 AMP、全範圍 ADP 與確認性分析的 Excel 分析範本，校正因子已內建；母液計算器、滴定設計工作表、盤面配置範本與滲透壓工作表；CellScope 影像分析流程（Cellpose 分割、OzaLabCP／Imageanalysis）並附公開的 vesicle_pipeline.txt；洗衣板插件與橡皮筋滑座的 STL 檔；原始時間序列資料與原始影像資料及遮罩也一併釋出。所有下載都集中在 https://2026.igem.wiki/calpolyslo/downloads，實驗手冊則以 CC BY 4.0 授權釋出。
techniques: Image segmentation with explicit QC gates

good.publicEngagement: The team designed CHEM 471: Engineering Synthetic Cells, described as the first known undergraduate synthetic-cell course in the US, wrote and tested ten open-licence (CC BY 4.0) lab manuals plus an instructor packet with prep lists, reagent costs, timing and common failure points, taught it to ten students in spring 2026, and surveyed them before and after. Confidence rose in 9 of 12 skills; the three that did not became design inputs. Students rated fluorescence microscopy lower at the end than at the start, so the microscope protocols were rewritten and re-tested by the team's least experienced members; manual cytosol-recipe maths was replaced by auto-scaling Excel calculators; NanoOrange/A280 protein quantification was replaced with a Bradford assay plus BSA standard curve; and the Promega AMP/ADP protocol was replaced with the team's own real-time assay. A student's suggestion became the tip-wipe oil-removal method that was then tested against the standard method.
good.publicEngagement_zh: 團隊設計了 CHEM 471：Engineering Synthetic Cells，據稱是美國第一門大學部的合成細胞課程；他們撰寫並實測了十份開放授權（CC BY 4.0）的實驗手冊，另加一份教師包，內含準備清單、試劑成本、時間安排與常見失敗點，2026 年春季開給十位學生，並在課前課後各做一次問卷。12 項技能中有 9 項信心上升；沒有上升的三項則成為設計輸入。學生在課程結束時對螢光顯微術的評分比開始時更低，因此顯微鏡的實驗流程被重寫，並由隊上經驗最少的成員重新測試；手算細胞質配方的部分換成會自動換算的 Excel 計算器；NanoOrange 與 A280 的蛋白定量換成 Bradford 分析加 BSA 標準曲線；Promega 的 AMP 與 ADP 流程則換成團隊自己的即時分析法。一位學生的建議變成後來的擦拭吸頭除油法，之後還拿去與標準方法對照測試。
good.ihp: Consultations with ethicists, legal and biosecurity scholars and industry scientists were run as feedback-to-action pairs. Dr Hank Greely advised publishing safety and containment thinking before starting work, so the team published aims, protocols, lab manuals and safety forms. Dr Ryan Jenkins recommended survivability testing as risk-assessment evidence, so the team tested whether synthetic cells survive outside the tube across pH, salinity and real environmental water samples (Los Osos Creek wetland, Avila Beach ocean water, campus pond, tap and deionised water) and found the cells lyse outside pH 7 +/- 1, at seawater salinity and in every environmental sample; he also prompted a lab-notebook safety checklist. Dr Keith Robison raised dual-use scenarios, which produced a benefits-vs-misuse framework. Dr Tae Seok Moon raised public perception, which produced IRB-approved surveys (Cal Poly IRB #2026-194 and #2026-195) of 10 CSHL Summer Synthetic Biology participants and 30 Cal Poly FSURP students on comfort, trust and regulation. Dr Zachary Sun's view that education may be the realistic near-term application reshaped the project's scope toward enzyme characterisation and teaching.
good.ihp_zh: 與倫理學者、法律與生物安全研究者以及產業科學家的諮詢，都以回饋對行動的配對方式進行。Dr Hank Greely 建議在開始實驗之前就先公開安全與圍堵的思考，於是團隊公開了研究目標、實驗流程、實驗手冊與安全表單。Dr Ryan Jenkins 建議把存活性測試當成風險評估的證據，於是團隊測試合成細胞在試管之外能否存活，涵蓋不同 pH、鹽度與真實環境水樣（Los Osos Creek 濕地、Avila Beach 海水、校園池水、自來水與去離子水），結果發現細胞在 pH 7 ± 1 之外、在海水鹽度下、以及在每一個環境水樣中都會破裂；他也促成了一份實驗紀錄簿的安全檢核表。Dr Keith Robison 提出兩用性情境，產出一套效益對誤用的評估框架。Dr Tae Seok Moon 提出公眾觀感問題，產出經 IRB 核准的問卷（Cal Poly IRB #2026-194 與 #2026-195），對 10 位 CSHL Summer Synthetic Biology 參與者與 30 位 Cal Poly FSURP 學生調查其接受度、信任感與對監管的看法。Dr Zachary Sun 認為教育可能才是近期內現實可行的應用，這個看法把專案的範圍重新導向酵素表徵與教學。
good.realWorld: The framing throughout is cost of access rather than novelty: PPK2 plus polyphosphate is pursued because it lowers the price floor of cell-free protein synthesis, and the 3D-printed washboard replaces a hand-raking step that varies between operators. The course is explicitly packaged as a template other undergraduate institutions can adopt, with reagent costs and set-up in an instructor packet, and the full protocol set released so other programmes can either reproduce the six enzyme-characterisation experiments or swap in their own enzymes. Six characterised PPK2 enzymes and sixteen candidate-panel enzymes are deposited as registry parts with their datasets linked.
good.realWorld_zh: 整份論述的切入點是取得成本，而不是新穎性：之所以追求 PPK2 加多磷酸鹽，是因為它能降低無細胞蛋白質合成的價格下限；而 3D 列印的洗衣板則取代了一個因操作者而異的手工刮動步驟。課程也被明確包裝成其他大學部單位可以直接採用的樣板，試劑成本與建置方式都寫在教師包裡，整套實驗流程也公開釋出，讓其他學程可以重現那六個酵素表徵實驗，或換成自己的酵素。六個已表徵的 PPK2 酵素與十六個候選組酵素都存入 Registry 成為零件，並連結其資料集。
partners: Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory Summer Synthetic Biology Program

gemsTakeaway: Before comparing anything, prove the measurement: validate the quench, establish the instrument's honest linear range and refuse to extrapolate outside it, then build a separate standard curve for every interfering condition and hard-code the resulting correction factors into the analysis template you ship. Then test reproducibility by handing the written protocol to people who have never run it, and publish the disagreement when their numbers differ from yours.
gemsTakeaway_zh: 在比較任何東西之前，先證明你的量測站得住腳：驗證反應終止方法、確立儀器誠實的線性範圍並拒絕外推，再為每一種會造成干擾的條件各建一條標準曲線，並把算出的校正因子直接寫進你要發布的分析範本裡。接著把寫好的實驗流程交給從沒做過的人來測重現性，而當他們的數字和你的不一樣時，就把這個不一致公開出來。
